source_user: Choose between tensor and pipeline parallelism for a latency-sensitive multi-GPU service. State the assumptions needed. Scenario variant 81: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: compare per-GPU memory, communication topology, layer partitioning, batch and microbatch behavior, synchronization, latency target, and failure/reconfiguration costs.
corrected_answer:
For scenario variant 81, do not choose tensor or pipeline parallelism from the prompt alone. Declare the model/checkpoint, precision, GPU count/type and usable memory in GiB, interconnect topology and placement, runtime/driver versions, power and clock policy, request prompt/output-length distributions, offered load, concurrency, batching policy, and SLA targets for end-to-end p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and TPOT in ms. Define throughput units, quality and correctness gates, error/availability budgets, and whether failed-rank recovery or reconfiguration is allowed; label all unmeasured values as assumptions or estimates.

Pre-register a falsifiable hypothesis with a numerical margin: at a named offered load and fixed gates, one feasible strategy will reduce held-out p99 latency by at least M ms or M% versus the other, without violating memory, quality, error, or availability limits. Enumerate feasible tensor degrees and pipeline layer partitions. Measure tensor shard memory, collective bytes/time, topology effects, synchronization waits, pipeline stage balance, activation memory, inter-stage transfer time, microbatch count, bubble fraction, queue depth, throughput, and per-request TTFT/TPOT and end-to-end latency. Record OOMs, timeouts, retries, stragglers, failed-rank recovery and reconfiguration time.

Use randomized interleaved paired trials on identical warmed replicas and identical request traces; keep tuning traces disjoint from held-out evaluation, repeat with a preregistered sample size and confidence-interval method, and stratify by prompt/output length, load, concurrency, topology and batch/microbatch settings. Control caches, compilation, thermal state, clocks, placement, background work, and measurement overhead. Inject bounded communication, worker and capacity failures only in an isolated authorized test environment; verify no data exposure, define timeout/drain/retry behavior, and retain a tested rollback to the last known-good configuration. Select only if the hypothesis and all gates pass; otherwise keep the known-good baseline and report uncertainty.

quality_dimensions.coverage: assumptions, mechanism, boundaries, failure modes, measurement, safety and rollback
quality_dimensions.precision: units and estimands explicit; unknown facts not invented

risks: Choice depends on unprovided hardware, topology, model and workload facts.
Tail latency can be confounded by batching, queueing, warm-up, thermal state or background load.
Failure results may not generalize beyond the tested implementation.
evidence_required: Held-out paired p99/TTFT/TPOT with confidence intervals at declared loads.
Memory, communication, synchronization, stage-balance, bubble, queueing and recovery telemetry.
Quality, correctness, error and availability gates plus a rollback drill.
